info.name: Switchboard · explicit sandbox approvals
info.description: Use Send on individual requests; do not use Run Collection for the payment flow. This project refuses live PayPal mode. No secrets are included. Cookie-based sessions must be retained across requests. Default localhost setup is fully mocked; the hosted browser demo uses PayPal sandbox and Gemini with simulated provider conversations. Payment approvals require human review. No post-response script calls another endpoint. For a complete hosted checkout, use the application UI and /demo walkthrough.

request.description: Creates a job in the cookie session. Save the returned jobId. Gemini may ask a follow-up question; answer it with the next request.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); if (data.jobId) pm.collectionVariables.set("jobId", data.jobId); }

request.description: Only if the planner asked a question. Edit the answer before sending.

Poll manually until QUOTED. Inspect price, availability, inclusions, confidence and decline status. Copy the chosen quoteId and its callId into collection variables; no quote is automatically selected.
Requires a callId from the snapshot. Conversations in the selected demo scope are simulated.

item.name: 4 · APPROVAL ONE: Book the chosen quote

request.description: Explicit booking approval. Check quoteId and amount first. Hosted mode returns a PayPal sandbox approveUrl. Complete buyer approval in a browser; for the hosted demo, using the browser UI throughout is easiest. Offline mock approval is simulated.
Only after CONFIRMED. Read and verify the returned email before approving completion. This action records recipient review.
Demo mode only. Moves a confirmed job to completion review; does not capture or pay out funds.

item.name: 7 · APPROVAL TWO: Mark done and release

request.description: Explicit completion and payment approval. Send individually only after reviewing the recipient and confirming completion. This queues sandbox capture and payout. Never run the collection indiscriminately.
After the invoice is PAID and independently verified. Hosted mode may redirect to the PayPal sandbox invoice. Pending preparation may return 202 or 404; review-required returns 409.
Use instead of completion approval while AWAITING_COMPLETION. Records an issue and retains an existing authorization without capture.
Use instead of payment release. Only supported in cancellable states before capture. Inspect the snapshot for the resulting void record.
